statements.impact_statement: RUSTSEC-2026-0370: the zvariant crate is no longer maintained as a separate crate; it has been merged into zbus 6.0.0 as its wire module. RustSec marks every zvariant release as affected, reports no vulnerability in it and lists no patched version: https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0370.html, https://github.com/z-galaxy/zbus/issues/2043 . We downloaded every build-dev package listed in the Alpine 3.23 index of the DHI Alpine repository, for x86_64 and aarch64: 91 versions from 2.6.4-r0 to the current 2.30.0-r0, with 2.6.4-r0 published for aarch64 only, and checked each download against the index checksum. 2.19.1-r1 is listed three times per architecture with different checksums; the copy the repository serves was the one read. No package contains a symbolic link. Each package holds one program, /usr/bin/build, a Go program built with GOOS=linux and CGO_ENABLED=0, which contains no Rust code; a byte search of every ELF file in every build finds no zbus, zvariant or proc-macro-error name. No build of this package contains uv or any Rust crate, so the crate is not present.

statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2026-0370: the zvariant crate is no longer maintained as a separate crate; it has been merged into zbus 6.0.0 as its wire module. RustSec marks every zvariant release as affected, reports no vulnerability in it and lists no patched version: https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0370.html, https://github.com/z-galaxy/zbus/issues/2043 . We downloaded every build-fips package listed in the Alpine 3.23 index of the authenticated DHI Alpine security repository, where the FIPS packages are published, for x86_64 and aarch64: 91 versions from 2.6.4-r0 to the current 2.30.0-r0, with 2.6.4-r0 published for aarch64 only, and checked each download against the index checksum. 2.19.1-r1 is listed three times per architecture with different checksums; the copy the repository serves was the one read. No package contains a symbolic link. Every build carries the Go program /usr/bin/build, from 2.26.2-r1 also the Go program /opt/docker/dhi/yq and from 2.28.0-r1 also the Go program /usr/bin/dhi-source, all built with CGO_ENABLED=0 and containing no Rust code. From 2.27.1-r1 (2.27.1-r1 to 2.30.0-r0, 12 versions) each build also carries /opt/docker/dhi/uv, the uv 0.13.6 Rust program, of which these builds hold five different binaries per architecture. A byte search of every ELF file in every build finds zbus, zvariant and proc-macro-error names only in /opt/docker/dhi/uv. We read the crate list that cargo-auditable embeds in each uv binary (its .dep-v0 section) in every build on both architectures, and searched each distinct uv binary for strings. In every uv binary the crate list names zvariant 5.11.0, used by zbus 5.15.0, which uv reaches through its uv-keyring crate and the secret-service crate (the Linux Secret Service keyring over D-Bus). Every distinct uv binary contains source paths of zvariant 5.11.0 (for example zvariant-5.11.0/src/dbus/de.rs and zvariant-5.11.0/src/value.rs), so the crate's code is compiled into uv. No published build carries zbus 6, so every build from 2.27.1-r1 on contains the unmaintained crate; the builds before 2.27.1-r1 carry no Rust program.
